_comment: uday.gift      the landing page — land.html, and nothing else
app.uday.gift  everything you can DO — index.html, the whole app
my.uday.gift   the app's old name, permanently redirected to app
Order matters: the first matching rule wins, so the community redirect
sits above the catch-all that would otherwise serve the landing page for
Rooms are the one thing already shared as links (uday.gift/c/<slug> is in
chat groups and X posts), so those must keep resolving. They 308 to the
app host rather than 404 or, worse, quietly render a landing page.
